name: Emerald Wrap Midi Dress
shortDescription: A flattering wrap-style midi dress in rich emerald, cinched at the waist with a self-tie belt.
description: Cut in a flattering wrap silhouette with a self-tie waist belt, this emerald midi dress moves easily from day to evening. A soft V-neckline and fluid drape make it a versatile addition to any wardrobe.
fit: Relaxed wrap fit, true to size
care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang to dry, cool iron if needed

name: Champagne Satin Slip Dress
shortDescription: A liquid-drape satin slip dress in champagne gold with adjustable straps.
description: Cut from a lustrous satin-feel fabric, this bias-cut slip dress skims the body for an effortlessly elegant look. Adjustable straps and a midi length make it easy to dress up or down.
care: Hand wash cold, do not wring, line dry in shade, low iron

name: Blush Floral Wrap Dress
shortDescription: A soft blush wrap dress with a delicate all-over floral print.
description: Finished in a delicate floral print on a soft blush base, this wrap dress features long sleeves and a flattering tie waist, perfect for daytime occasions and light layering.
fit: Relaxed wrap fit, true to size
care: Machine wash cold gentle cycle, hang to dry, cool iron

name: Ivory Tiered Maxi Dress
shortDescription: A breezy tiered maxi dress in ivory with a relaxed, flowing silhouette.
description: Designed with soft tiers for movement and volume, this ivory maxi dress features a relaxed fit, subtle smocked waist, and flutter sleeves for an easy, elegant everyday look.
care: Machine wash cold, do not tumble dry, cool iron if needed

name: Terracotta Puff-Sleeve Midi Dress
shortDescription: A warm terracotta midi dress with statement puff sleeves and a fitted waist.
description: Balanced with voluminous puff sleeves and a fitted waist seam, this terracotta midi dress makes a warm, confident statement while remaining comfortable enough for all-day wear.
care: Machine wash cold, hang to dry, medium iron

name: Black Tailored Shirt Dress
shortDescription: A crisp black shirt dress with a tailored collar and belted waist.
description: A wardrobe staple, this black shirt dress is tailored with a structured collar, button-through front, and a fabric belt to define the waist. Equally suited to the office or evening.
care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low, warm iron

name: Champagne Pleated Blouse
shortDescription: A softly pleated champagne blouse with a fluid, elegant drape.
description: Finished with fine all-over pleating, this champagne blouse catches the light beautifully with every movement. A relaxed fit and button cuffs keep it polished yet comfortable.
care: Hand wash cold, line dry, do not iron pleats directly

name: Ivory Silk-Feel Camisole Top
shortDescription: A lightweight ivory camisole with a silk-like finish, perfect for layering.
description: Cut from a lightweight satin-feel fabric, this ivory camisole layers effortlessly under blazers or co-ords, or stands alone for a refined, minimal look.
care: Hand wash cold, do not wring, line dry

name: Sage Green Knot-Front Top
shortDescription: A relaxed sage green top with a flattering knot detail at the front.
description: A soft sage green top finished with a front knot detail that flatters the waist. Short sleeves and a breathable fabric make it a warm-weather favorite.
care: Machine wash cold, hang to dry, cool iron

name: Blush Ruffle Sleeve Blouse
shortDescription: A romantic blush blouse with soft ruffle sleeve detailing.
description: Feminine ruffle sleeves and a soft blush tone give this blouse a romantic edge, while the relaxed body and tie neckline keep it easy to wear day to day.
care: Hand wash cold, hang to dry, cool iron

name: Black Essential Wrap Top
shortDescription: A versatile black wrap top designed to pair with everything.
description: A everyday essential, this black wrap top features a flattering surplice neckline and a soft, stretch-friendly fabric that pairs easily with trousers, skirts, or co-ords.

name: Emerald Wide-Leg Co-ord Set

shortDescription: An elevated champagne satin co-ord set for special occasions.
